research_status: Exploratory retrospective market study, not an uninspected future holdout
time_unit: native provider/SPY-supported trading-session rows, independent exchange-calendar verification false; no86400crypto mask
prepared_features: Loader supplies5200 arithmetic-return rows,5201 positive close rows before transform. Fixed12 identities, no filling or shrinking cohort; sampleSD>1e-12 required for every graph.

channels.positive_lambda2_over_n: Second eigenvalue of diag(W+1)-W+, W+=max(C,0), diagonal0, divided by fixed n12.
channels.negative_mean_weight: Mean max(-Cij,0) across ALL unordered off-diagonal pairs, including zero weights; negative-channel strength.
channels.negative_lambda2_over_n: Literal negative-magnitude Laplacian second eigenvalue/n; full descriptivehistory and separate W60/H20 future_mean+endpoint experiments. Disconnected support gives exact0; degeneracy is reported, not relabeled.

targets.future_mean: mean(score_W[t+1:t+H+1])-score_W[t]; require EVERY future rolling score, never skip missing.
targets.endpoint: score_W[t+H]-score_W[t], fitted and evaluated separately; never substituted for future_mean.
targets.future_disjoint_diagnostic: score(Corr(nextH returns))-score(Corr(previousH returns)); matched H-observation samples with disjoint raw returns. Descriptive diagnostic, not interchangeable with the rolling-score target.

overlap: W60/H20 future rolling windows contain82.5% already-known return slots on average; endpoint shares40/60. These count overlap, not explained variance. StrideH targets remain dependent, including shared endpoint scores.

features.current: Current target-channel score, positive lambda2/n, negative meanweight, mean Pearson, minimum positive degree/n, positive density r>=.3, negative density r<=-.1, equal-weight return basket annualized SDsqrt252.
features.known_components: All regression variants share positive/negative strength summaries of current window outgoing min(H,W) and retained max(W-H,0) returns; absent or constant subwindows are model-feature NaN, never imputed source prices.
features.trajectory: Current+known features plus FOUR same-channel summaries over lastK score endpoints including current: endpoint change, mean minus current, sampleSD, linear slope; not K independent coefficients.
features.lags: Lagged SCORE histories are not directed asset lead-lag edges. No directed lead-lag or causal claim; such an experiment is future work.

models.local_mean60: Future score=mean previous60 observed graph scores including current, minus current for delta.
models.AR1: OLS one-session score autoregression using only score-pair label dates strictly before forecast-block origin; recursively forecast nextH scores, then take mean or endpoint as specified. Strong causal baseline, no future score inputs.
models.current: Ridge with current and shared known-window features.
models.trajectory_selected: Ridge with K20/60/100 and alpha .1/1/10/100 selected using earlier inner tuning MAE; current alpha chosen earlier separately; tie to larger alpha then smallerK.
models.ridge_objective: sum squared residuals+alpha*sum slope coefficients squared; intercept unpenalized. Train-only medians, missing flags, population centering/scaling; constant columns dropped.
models.bounds: All score future levels lie within[0,1]. Clip predicted LEVELS to[0,1] identically at tuning/calibration/test/latest; compute delta afterward. Save raw and clipped predictions. Clip residual scenario/interval future LEVELS consistently; preserve unclipped interval as diagnostic.

splits.schedule: Common start position218=maxW120-1+maxK100-1. For each H, stop at last source row minusH. Final25% scheduled as-of rows are outerevaluation, in20-row blocks. W,channel and target comparisons for a fixedH use matched eligible dates.
splits.inner: At each outerorigin b, source positions i with i+H<b are matured horizon labels. First60% of matured scheduledspan fits; next20% tunes; final20% calibrates. PurgeH endpoints before tuning andH before calibration.
splits.calibration: Chosen model settings fixed using earlier tuning. Calibration predictions come from earlier expanding20-row origins with training label dates strictly before each origin. Use shared global20-row calibration origin grid for caching, never in-sample residuals or own later outcomes.
splits.refit: After settings chosen, refit ridge on all horizon labels matured strictly before outerorigin. AR1 uses only its own one-step labels strictly before origin. Both can use current/past predictors on each forecast date inside the block.
splits.selection: Select K/alpha per fixedW,H,channel,target. W/H define different estimands and are not selected by comparing rawMAE. MainW60/H20 coprimary; all other cases and endpoint models are secondary with explicit multiplicity cautions.

probabilities.band: Per experiment freeze b=.5*sampleSD(targetdelta) from fittingsegment at initial outerorigin. Down delta<-b, flat abs(delta)<=b, up delta>b. No economic significance implied.
probabilities.method: Earlier rolling calibration residuals shifted by point forecast, futurelevels clipped[0,1], then category counts; one pseudo-count per physically feasible class, probabilities renormalized. Not a forcedGamma law or distribution-free conditional probability guarantee.
probabilities.interval: Nominal90% previous rolling residual5th/95thpercentiles around point forecast, clipped at physical futurelevel bounds; report actual outercoverage and width. Dependence/drift can make coverage fail.
probabilities.degeneracy: A channel with allzero fittingtargets has band0; preserve literal score, report degeneracy and baseline behavior instead of inventing spectral information.

grading.point: MAE primary, RMSE/bias supplemental; compare all five models on identical case dates.
grading.probability: Threeclass Brier=sum squared categorical probability errors, fixed probability calibration bins and counts, nominal90% interval coverage.
grading.uncertainty: Paired absolute-error differences, circular moving-block bootstrap1000 replicates seed20261015; blocks60 and max(60,W+H-1) to expose overlap sensitivity. Conditional on saved forecasts; not familywise correction or fresh validation.
grading.stride: EveryHth SCHEDULED outerdate for allH offsets, scores/counts only; not independent because graph history and endpoint scores overlap.
grading.multiple_testing: 48 main-grid estimands plus2 literal negative-lambda2 diagnostics. Report all rows/selectioncounts; no best-market or universal-best-horizon claim. No posthoc model expansion based on scores.

latest: Separate observed source session/date, actual issueUTC, retrievaltime and targetH future sessions; exact futuredate only if independently supplied calendar. Pending targets remain null. Freeze issued forecasts for later scoring.
outputs: index.json; cases/<id>.json; comparison.csv; predictions.csv.gz; selection.csv; score_history.csv.gz; latest.json; checks.json. All calculations Python; parent owns plots/deck.
budget: 0USD additional, no orders or credentials; no SEC/news acquisition; later economic inputs require official publication as-of timestamps. Preserve all crypto and original frozenfiles.
